Name: Animated Furniture and Stuff
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Animated Furniture and Stuff

[/u][/b][/size][size=3]The idea of this mod is to bring a little more life to a game I love. I animated a lot of items in this mod, so I highly recommend to check out the [/size][i]config.json[/i][size=3] file so you can choose which items you want animated and which you do not. More details in the config section below. Also some of the gifs shown on this page are not a perfect loop, so please don't judge them as the final product. [/size]

[size=4][color=#FF0000][b][center]! Spoiler warning ! A lot of the gifs show items that are unlocked ingame ! Spoiler warning ! [/center][/b][/color]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/LVj1AGi.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/YqN1nYQ.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/TdCBL4M.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/paBqmbe.gif[/img][/center][u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)

[/size][size=5][u][b]Config[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]There is a [/size][i]config.json[/i][size=3] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.[/size]
[size=3]You can also change the speed of the animation in the [/size][i]content.json[/i][size=3] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.[/size]

[size=3]Some items have different versions, for example: "ChristmasTree1" and "ChristmasTree2". [/size][size=4][b][u]You can only have one of these enabled in the [i]config.json [/i]at one time[/u]. [/b][/size]

[u][b][size=5]Extra
[/size][/b][/u][size=3][s]You can use the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2276]Furniture Anywhere[/url] to place furniture anywhere, the animations will still work outside the farm house with this mod.
[/s][/size]SDV 1.5 now allows you to place furniture outside.
